title: how to check which database is used in dbt when running dbt run command?
answer:
ANALYTICS is the default database name for dbt-snowflake, which would lead me to think that dbt can't find the profile you've defined. Some possible causes:

  1. Your profiles file needs to have a top-level key that matches the profile name defined in your dbt_project.yml file. From that file, that name should be my-snowflake-dbt-db. So your profiles file should start with a key with that name:

    my-snowflake-dbt-db:
  target: dev
  outputs:
    dev:
      type: snowflake
  ...

  2. dbt expects the profiles file to be called profiles.yml (note the s), and it should be located at ~/.dbt/profiles.yml on unix systems. For a different path, you can run dbt with the --profiles-dir option.

Finally, there is a command to help with all of this: dbt debug. That will run a check and tell you if it can find your profile, connect to your database, etc. Docs
